page.overview:
Who is Bren?

Bren was a male Human agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service living during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY he was stationed in the Section X area of Belsavis, investigating the wreckage of the Fatality cruiser in the Frozen Lake.

Bren appears in the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic as an NPC in Section X, added in Update 1.5.
